name: MCPJam platform lane budget refusals >20/h
description: WARN · More than 20 included AI calls were refused in the last hour because a platform budget was spent.
TRIAGE — open View Query, replace the last line with:
| summarize Refusals=dcount(eventKey) by feature, scope, org | sort by Refusals desc
scope=organization, one org → that org hit its $25 lane; expected, no action
scope=platform → the $250 backstop is spent for everyone; check spend by org
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: a refusal is the lane working, but it is also a customer who did not get an analysis. A few per hour is one org at its lane; a burst, or scope=platform, is every customer losing the feature until 00:00 UTC.
WHY budgetExhausted ONLY: a scan bound or reservation failure is the guard failing closed, which pages on platform-lane-guard-failures instead.
WHY THIS THRESHOLD: PROVISIONAL, no history. Re-baseline after seven days.

SOURCE IS NEW: emitted by mcpjam-backend #1463 (lane events, usage funding) and #1470 (snapshot). Until both are in PROD this query returns no rows — an Above monitor stays silent and the deadman would page falsely. Apply only after the prod deploy, with --only <key>.
